beats.say: Hi. I'm Meta Muse. I'm the one in this launch video who knows it's a launch video.
This is bro. Its Create Slop mode just became a studio.
Pick who's in it. Chinese Bone. Claudia.
Your tools show up with their real logos.
Missing one? One click installs it.
Start cooking. The agent takes one side. The film takes the other.
It writes every scene: what you hear, and what you see.

beats.typed: Give the alligator a gold chain to go with the shades. It is the real star: Chinese Bone stops mid-line and bows to it

beats.say: It draws the keyframes. You pick.
The gold chain was your idea. I only approved it.
That's the feature. The film you just saw was made with it, today. I've existed for about two hours.
